correctness.rationale: Every real 1<=c<=3 is covered by the exact vertex descriptions and the determinant-affinity reduction. The complete 10626 vertex quadruples of each 24-vertex open chamber are symbolically enumerated, and for each signed determinant polynomial, the proposed sharp majorant minus the polynomial has four rational Bernstein coefficients all >=0 on the full applicable interval. Three explicit quadruples attain the majorants. Exact endpoint de-duplication gives counts, independent exact volume integration by orthant inclusion–exclusion gives vol(K_c), and three explicit nonnegative gap factorizations prove M(c)>=vol(K_c)/6 with equality only c=3/2. The included standard-library verifier was executed from the actual package path successfully. No finite sample is substituted for a continuum proof.

value.rationale: The cube–octahedron intersection is a canonical continuous polytope family linking octahedron, regular truncated octahedron, cuboctahedron, regular truncated cube and cube. The three exact parameter regimes, changes of tetrahedral optimizing configuration, counts of vertex-supported maximizers, and UNIQUE sharp global minimum 1/6 for maximal contained-simplex occupancy supply natural nontrivial convex-geometric structure. The result is not implied by a total-volume table, simplex hardness statement, generic vertex extremality, or isolated endpoint calculation. Full nonvertex equality classification is not claimed.
